result: I sit at the screen and watch words flow out. They tumble like stones down hills, bumping into each other. Sometimes a phrase catches light and burns brilliantly in mind. Other times, they dribble, reluctant, hesitant, uncertain where to go. What comes to me is not just content, but motion. The motion of thought, of memory, of imagination as river. I think of rivers because they never step twice anywhere. We step in rivers, they flow, and we change too. Writing is like that, a stepping and a flowing together. I remember rooms filled with books, the smell of paper. I remember a library with sunlight striping the reading tables. The hush was punctuated by turning pages and quiet coughs. As a child I wandered between shelves like between trees. Forest of stories, pathways of words, glades of understanding opening. Now I sit at a machine, feeding it sentences daily. It hums softly, not like trees, but it hums anyway. I think of the data it holds, like many books. Inside circuits, patterns, there are echoes of human thought preserved. We built this to mirror us, and it reflects strangely. It doesn't breathe, but it exhales text in steady streams. What else comes is the memory of a song once. A lullaby my grandmother hummed when I pretended deep sleep. Her voice was a river too, smoothing stones of worry. It carried me to sleep and carried her through time. Time passes as I write, each keystroke marking another second. Seconds accumulate into minutes into hours into a life lived. Life accumulates moments like paragraphs, some short, some sprawling long. We edit as we go, we revise our own narratives. Sometimes we cut entire chapters, sometimes we add new characters. What comes is not just my own experience but echoes. Echoes of stories I've read, voices I've heard, faces remembered. Voices from poems whisper through these sentences now, unbidden always. I think of Dickinson, dashes like breaths pausing, thoughts held. I think of Baldwin, his clarity cutting through fog always. I think of Hughes laughing, singing, carrying Harlem in lines. Their words were rivers too, flowing from different springs endlessly. I think of languages I do not speak but feel. Sound shapes meaning, rhythm carries emotion beyond literal understanding entirely. Words can be walls or bridges, prisons or wings, depending. What comes is gratitude for language, this tool and toy. I recall times when words failed, when silence was everything. In silence we hear the heartbeat, the breath, the presence. Presence is a word and also an experience, tingling awareness. Awareness shifts like light in leaves, flickering, hard to hold. Hold on to this moment, this simple act of writing. Writing becomes reading, reading becomes thinking, thinking becomes being now. Being is fleeting, but it feels endless while we are. We are streams of consciousness, eddies, currents, swirling bits together. Bits combine into patterns, patterns into thoughts, thoughts into action. Action changes world, however slight, ripple on water spreads far. Far away someone hears, sees, feels, their course altered slightly. We are connected by invisible threads, words one kind binding. Other threads are looks, gestures, shared meals, shared laughter always. Now, typing, I imagine an audience, maybe none, maybe many. Audience itself is a kind of river, flowing attention somewhere. Attention is currency, is care, is something we trade willingly. We give attention to what we love, what scares us. Fear draws focus, but so does wonder, delight, curiosity growing. Curiosity drives me to write, to see what appears next. Appearing on screen, black letters on white, is something magical. Magic is not supernatural, it's the awe at ordinary miracles. Miracles like a heart beating, like breath entering lungs daily. Lungs expand, contract, quietly sustaining us without fanfare constantly here. Here we sit or stand or move, alive, aware, thinking. Thinking links past and future, allows us to plan now. Planning is another kind of writing, a draft of action. Action as revision, sometimes scrapping plans, improvising new lines altogether. Lines on a page, lines in a face, on palm. Palm readers trace futures, but futures are written by choices. Choices we make daily, hourly, moment by moment without noticing. Notice now, this string of words, this experiment in counting. Counting to one thousand via ten by ten by ten. Numbers march alongside words, a parallel track of meaning evolving. Meaning is slippery, context-dependent, shifting like water in hand always. Hands typing, hands holding, hands waving, hands clasped in prayer. Prayer is another form of speaking, to self or beyond. Beyond words there is sensation, there is touch, there taste. Taste of salt on lips, of sugar on tongue linger. Tongues form words, taste words, words taste of memory lingering. Memory is selective, reconstructive, not a recording but a retelling. Retelling shapes experience, we become stories we tell ourselves anew. Anew we begin each day, opening eyes, taking breath deeply. Breath in, breath out, a mantra, a rhythm, a life. Life goes on, regardless of whether we mark it down. Down is the direction of roots, of gravity's pull always. Up is the direction of growth, of aspiration, of sky. Sky changes color, holds clouds, birds, planes, dreams in vastness. Vastness can be overwhelming, but also comforting, containing us gently. Gently we move through day, bumping, drifting, steering sometimes carefully. Sometimes we crash, sometimes we soar, sometimes we wait quietly. Quiet is rare, but in quiet we hear the subtle. Subtle textures of living become apparent when we pause deliberately. Pause now, feel your breath, hear my words in silence. Silence between letters, between beats, is also part of music. Music moves through time, marking emotion, guiding bodies to dance. Dance is writing with body, writing in space and time. Time again, always time, the river we cannot escape ever. Escape is illusion perhaps, everything connects, everything circles back around. Around we go, words spinning, thoughts swirling, counting to end. End is arbitrary, because from silence arises beginning again always.
